title: Campania Registry On Peripheral Artery Disease
official: Campania Registry On Peripheral Artery Disease
summary: The CAmpania REgistry on Peripheral Artery Disease (CARE-PAD) is a single-center observational study which has the purpose to collect clinical, laboratory, instrumental, procedural and follow-up data and to evaluate the outcome of peripheral artery disease (PAD) patients.
